Addiction Statistics in San Jose

Regular use and misuse of drugs are often signs that someone may be struggling with an addiction. Addiction is similar to other medical concerns that continue to worsen until proper treatment is received. In regard to addiction, treatment often includes abstinence and behavioral changes.
In California, 16.1% of 18-25-year-olds are living with a substance use disorder. Commonly abused drugs in California include alcohol, marijuana, pain medications, cocaine, meth, and heroin.

Approximately 7.7 million adults are living with a dual diagnosis, meaning that they are living with a substance use disorder and another mental health concern. In California, this equates to approximately 7.6% of the population. While some individuals can tell you which came before the others, this is not always the case. The most important detail is that receiving treatment for both concerns at the same time increases your chances of having a healthy and lasting recovery. Mental health concerns and addiction are often intertwined, so it is important to reflect that in your treatment program.

How to Find Detox Programs in San Jose, CA

Making the decision to get help for drug and alcohol abuse may bring a moment of relief knowing that you are a step closer to making a change. However, for some, this sensation can dissipate quickly if they are unsure of where they can go for help.

If you are in a place where you need a detox program, there are a few resources that can help point you in the right direction. One of which would be health care professionals or a mental health care provider. These professionals are familiar with symptoms associated with substance use disorders, and can likely provide you with a treatment recommendation based on your needs. Referrals provided could be local treatment facilities or others that they are familiar with.

Another option available to you is to speak with your healthcare insurance provider. By speaking with your insurance provider, you can gain a better understanding of the specific details of your healthcare plan and how they would impact your financial ability for various treatment options. Additionally, you can learn more about what you can expect to pay out of pocket, including any copays and deductibles.

If you have been struggling with alcohol or drugs, you may benefit from a San Jose rehab program. What are the Benefits of a San Jose Rehab Program

San Jose rehab programs allow you to put some distance between you and your home environment. You would be in a supportive, compassionate, and substance-free space that encourages you to work towards a healthier lifestyle.

Over the years, addiction treatment programs have changed the focus of their treatment based on treatment outcomes. More often than not, addiction treatment programs utilize a holistic approach that allows you to include various areas of your life that were impacted by your substance use, rather than focusing solely on your recovery. This can include your behaviors, other mental health concerns, relationships, and finding new hobbies and interests that support a healthy recovery.

If you are living with another mental health concern, it is important to look for an addiction treatment program that offers dual-diagnosis treatment which provides treatment for both concerns. Additionally, medication-assisted treatment is an option for individuals who would benefit from the use of psychotropic medications for their mental health or addiction.

Addiction treatment programs recognize that recovery is not completed after one treatment program. For many, continued treatment is the most beneficial approach. Treatment programs can help you find additional treatment options that can support your recovery. As an example, if you attend a detoxification program, they will help you locate an inpatient or outpatient treatment program that would be a good fit for you and your recovery.
